source.publication: 2025 DR 0104 Booklet (Colorado Individual Income Tax), DR 0104 and DR 0104AD
source.section: DR 0104 lines 1, 10-13 (PDF p.8 Line 1; p.10 Lines 10-13); tax rate 4.4% (PDF p.10 Line 13); tax table (PDF p.34-35) and over-50,000 worksheet (PDF p.35); record brackets cite

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (you) 80,000.00 = 80,000.00. Federal taxable income = 80,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 64,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). DR 0104 line 1 federal taxable income (Form 1040 line 15) 64,250.00; lines 2-9 additions 0.00 (no state income tax addback, no other-state bond interest; federal AGI 80,000.00 is not over 300,000, so no line 4 deduction addback); line 10 subtotal 64,250.00. DR 0104AD: No subtractions (no Social Security, pension, military or railroad income). Line 22 subtotal = 0.00; DR 0104 line 11 = 0.00. Line 12 Colorado taxable income = 64,250.00 - 0.00 = 64,250.00. Line 13 tax = 4.4% x 64,250.00 = 2,827.00 (taxable income over 50,000: the PDF p.35 worksheet multiplies by .044, same figure). No credits claimed: 0.00. Colorado income tax 2,827.00.
